name: Yadeesha Weerasinghe
bio:
Yadeesha joined the Augmented Human Lab at the National University of Singapore (NUS) as a Research Intern and is currently an undergraduate at the University of Colombo School of Computing. Her focus on Human Computer Interactions, Educational Technology, and Assistive Technologies reflects a passion for improving lives through innovative solutions.

Beyond her academic pursuits, Yadeesha is an enthusiastic hockey player, and in her free time, she enjoys baking, hiking, and reading.
